summary: The registrant filed an 8-K announcing a routine quarterly cash dividend of $0.18 per share, which is a regular event and not a special situation. The filing includes no details about any corporate action such as acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, tender offers, going-private transactions, capital returns, spin-offs, rights offerings, restructuring, liquidations, delistings, issuer tenders, deal terminations, SPAC activity, or forced management changes. The dividend declaration is an ordinary capital allocation decision. Therefore, this filing does not warrant classification under any special-situations category.
